## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Mixed internals — cyclicals (Industrials, Energy, Staples) showing outsized gains while Technology is weak, supporting a neutral stance with no clear directional bias.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Communication leads: VZ (1W: +17.62% | 1M: +16.12%) ABOVE TREND, T (1W: +16.65% | 1M: +10.52%) ABOVE TREND, CHTR (1W: +16.26% | 1M: +1.65%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: FDX (1W: +13.13% | 1M: +20.57%) ABOVE TREND, CAT (1W: +10.01% | 1M: +17.73%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples participation: PEP (1W: +9.46% | 1M: +14.50%) ABOVE TREND, WMT (1W: +9.21% | 1M: +13.26%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: MSFT (1W: -14.43% | 1M: -13.05%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -11.57% | 1M: -20.76%) BELOW TREND, CRM (1W: -14.07% | 1M: -22.57%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare weak: TMO (1W: -8.63% | 1M: -3.78%) BELOW TREND, ISRG (1W: -8.79% | 1M: -14.79%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary soft: BKNG (1W: -9.87% | 1M: -12.75%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: VZ (1W: +17.62% | 1M: +16.12%) ABOVE TREND; T (1W: +16.65% | 1M: +10.52%) ABOVE TREND; CHTR (1W: +16.26% | 1M: +1.65%) ABOVE TREND; TXN (1W: +15.28% | 1M: +27.69%) ABOVE TREND; FDX (1W: +13.13% | 1M: +20.57%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated across 3 sectors in Top 5 (Communication, Technology, Industrials) — watch for concentration risk.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: TMO (1W: -8.63% | 1M: -3.78%) BELOW TREND; ISRG (1W: -8.79% | 1M: -14.79%) BELOW TREND; BKNG (1W: -9.87% | 1M: -12.75%) BELOW TREND; ORCL (1W: -11.57% | 1M: -20.76%) BELOW TREND; ACN (1W: -12.54% | 1M: -7.21%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in large-cap software and select healthcare names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: VZ (1W: +17.62% | 1M: +16.12%) ABOVE TREND, T (1W: +16.65% | 1M: +10.52%) ABOVE TREND, TXN (1W: +15.28% | 1M: +27.69%) ABOVE TREND. Watch the divergence between strong semis (TXN, INTC) and broad software/large-cap tech selling — tactical opportunities but not a regime change.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed to weak with concentration of large-cap software selling; TXN (1W: +15.28% | 1M: +27.69%) ABOVE TREND and INTC (1W: +12.11% | 1M: +25.06%) ABOVE TREND contrast with MSFT (1W: -14.43% | 1M: -13.05%) BELOW TREND and NVDA (1W: -4.34% | 1M: -4.51%) BELOW TREND. Sector performance: Technology underperformed this week after big-cap losses.

8. Financials Outlook?
Mixed recovery bias: JPM (1W: +4.84% | 1M: -2.83%) RECOVERY, V (1W: +1.13% | 1M: -5.07%) RECOVERY, MA (1W: +5.82% | 1M: -2.06%) RECOVERY versus PYPL (1W: -24.88% | 1M: -28.28%) BELOW TREND. Financials show patchy strength but internal dispersion — monitor earnings/sentiment drivers.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Soft overall: JNJ (1W: +3.86% | 1M: +12.42%) ABOVE TREND is a bright spot, while TMO (1W: -8.63% | 1M: -3.78%) BELOW TREND, ISRG (1W: -8.79% | 1M: -14.79%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -3.47% | 1M: -7.12%) BELOW TREND weigh on the sector; watch news-driven moves for dispersion.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclical/value exposures showing leadership (CAT (1W: +10.01% | 1M: +17.73%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +5.04% | 1M: +17.19%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +14.20%) ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to large-cap software names showing broad weakness (MSFT, ORCL, CRM all BELOW TREND); monitor AAPL (1W: +4.34% | 1M: -0.56%) RECOVERY for confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: TXN (1W: +15.28% | 1M: +27.69%) ABOVE TREND for momentum continuation; FDX (1W: +13.13% | 1M: +20.57%) ABOVE TREND for industrial cyclicals. BEARISH: MSFT (1W: -14.43% | 1M: -13.05%) BELOW TREND and PYPL (1W: -24.88% | 1M: -28.28%) BELOW TREND for downside follow-through.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Communication (week outperformance driven by VZ/T/CHTR; Breadth: overall market 7/11 positive). BEARISH: Technology (broad large-cap software weakness) and Healthcare (mixed, headline-driven moves).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Monitor tech downside confirmation (MSFT weekly lows and NVDA 1M trend breach would signal extended risk), watch TXN and INTC to hold their 1W gains for semiconductor leadership confirmation, and track WMT/PEP follow-through above recent weekly highs to validate staple-led rotation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
ISRG (+80): FDA cardiac clearance — price 1W: -8.79% | 1M: -14.79% BELOW TREND, sentiment diverging from price (watch for catch-up or fade). VZ (+55): Frontier deal and buyback focus — price 1W: +17.62% | 1M: +16.12% ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirming strength. CVX (+50): Aseng deal — price 1W: +5.32% | 1M: +14.20% ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirming.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
PYPL (-65): Earnings miss and weak outlook — price 1W: -24.88% | 1M: -28.28% BELOW TREND, sentiment confirming. NVDA (-60): China AI sales review headline — price 1W: -4.34% | 1M: -4.51% BELOW TREND, sentiment confirming downside risk. CHTR (-45): Spectrum subscriber loss headline — price 1W: +16.26% | 1M: +1.65% ABOVE TREND, sentiment diverging (distribution risk to watch).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, favor Value/Cyclical style given Industrials/Energy/Staples leadership and 7/11 sectors positive. TXN (1W: +15.28% | 1M: +27.69%) ABOVE TREND, VZ (1W: +17.62% | 1M: +16.12%) ABOVE TREND, and CAT (1W: +10.01% | 1M: +17.73%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk is concentrated tech weakness and headline-driven divergences (e.g., ISRG sentiment vs price, CHTR negative news while rallying) — monitor for confirmation before broadening allocations.
